sentences.text: Very little material is known about Ilchunaia, as only the anterior portion of the skull remains for study because the holotype was lost.
Fossils of Ilchunaia have been found in the Divisadero Largo Formation of Argentina from the Late Eocene.
Fossils of Ilchunaia have also been found in a locality in Mendoza, Argentina, dating to the Oligocene.
Ilchunaia is classified within the family Sebecidae.

The classification of Ilchunaia within Sebecosuchidae has been questioned, and recent analyses show the family was entirely paraphyletic, with some members likely being basal sebecosuchians ancestral to baurusuchids.
Ilchunaia lived from the Lutetian to the Priabonian, between 42 and 36 million years ago.
